text:
deploy-bot: promo to production blocked — staging artifact upload failed verification (checksum mismatch). CI pipeline aborted. See logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/32678

maria: saw this. Error in artifact s3 upload step. Hash on registry vs computed hash differ.

sam: can you paste the failing log snippet?

maria: ```
[upload] uploading artifact: models/redwood-v2/sha256:abc123...
[s3] put-object: 200 OK
[verify] expected sha256: abc123, got: 9f8b7c
ERROR: artifact checksum mismatch
``` 

chris: we had a cache-restore race earlier on the runner, might be corrupted cache layer. @oncall-ci can you check runner disk health?

oncall-ci: investigating. Disk I/O spike on runner-12 around 12:34UTC, cache restore retried twice. Re-running integrity check now.

eva: what's the rollback plan if we can't fix quickly? We need to keep the release window.

sam: proposal: pin promote to last-known-good image tag (prod: release-2026-03-20-rc4) and bypass artifact promotion for this build. Manual promote command: `deploy-bot promote --image release-2026-03-20-rc4 --env prod --reason "artifact checksum mismatch"`

maria: confirmed rc4 artifacts verified. I can run the manual promote if we agree.

chris: +1. Also open a ticket to invalidate CI cache for that job family to prevent future corrupt restores: ticket #INF-4321

deploy-bot: suggested action: hold auto-promo, manual promote allowed by release-owners. Fallback policy engaged: route traffic to rc4 if manual promote OK.

maria: doing manual promote now. ETA 3m.

maria: done. `deploy-bot promote` returned success: promotion id promo-32678-manual

sam: updating release notes and notifying product: "production remains at release-2026-03-20-rc4 while investigation is ongoing."

eva: create postmortem if this blocks more than one hour. assign to infra and ci teams.

chris: assigning INF-4321 to infra/ci; adding logs and runner id.

oncall-ci: cache invalidated for runner family, and we scheduled a rebuild of the artifact with clean cache. Re-run queued build 32679.

deploy-bot: build 32679 started.

maria: thanks all. closing this thread once CI finishes and artifact verifies.

sam: thumbs up :thumbsup:
